upstream_differences.description: Red canton starts at y=3.6 (visible white top edge); blue canton starts x=3.2 (white left edge). Upstream April 2026 removes these borders. Upstream retains uneven canton split at x=323 and y=225.3, so upstream is not geometrically authoritative.
Local green base x=0,width=512; upstream base x=2,width=510 causes partial transparent left edge. Keep local fix.

additional_findings.description: Green base begins x=2.4 instead of x=0; edge alpha becomes <255 along left side. 907 nonopaque pixels when rendered at 1200x900; same defect exists upstream.

Native uses green #2a936a, gold #ffc20e, red #be1e2d, black #000000. Variant icons use green #399408, gold #ffde08, red #de2110, black #000001. No authoritative numerical RGB values found, so no claim either palette legally wrong.

Canvas 640x480 quarter boundaries expected at x=320,y=240 for equal quarters; local/upstream x=323,y=225.3. Therefore top band is46.9375% tall and bottom53.0625%. Panama CONASINA reference depicts equal quarters and centered stars; ordinary flag3:2,but4:3/1:1 are icon variants and aspect conversion itself not an error.

Guyana Ministry of Education textbook (2021 revised edition),printed163/PDF175, gives red16%,black4%,gold24%,white6%,green50%. Local geometry color areas differ substantially, particularly native red21.17% and gold18.31%; 4:3 red18.04%,gold17.62%. These are rendered solid-color pixel fractions, antialiasing not assigned. Native flag aspect5:3 matches constitutional land ratio. Treat as geometry research item, not automatic replacement based on textbook alone. IMPORTANT: the textbook illustration on the same page visually places the inner black triangle apex near50% of width, apparently inconsistent with the area table. Do not classify Guyana design geometry as wrong from this table; further authoritative construction standard needed.
